content.body: With the imminent threat of Germany invading Britain and the demand on SMG's being incredibly high, the Sten Gun was born as a cheap and effective alternative. It was in service from 1941 to the 1960's, and was apart of almost every major conflict throughout that time period.
content.brief: WEAPON: Sten Mk. II AMMO: 9x19mm Parabellum MAGAZINE: 32 round clip MUZZLE VELOCITY: 365 m/s RATE OF FIRE: 500+/- rpm OTHER EQUIPMENT: Webley .455 cal (11.6 mm) Revolver No.36 Mills Bomb HE Grenades (4) No.77 Mk I Smoke Grenades (2) Combat Knife
